speaker: Doctor
text: Since you haven't answered any questions yet, let's begin. Have you noticed any easy bruising or bleeding gums, and does this happen to your siblings as well? Also, have you had any recent infections or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP). The clinical presentation of mucosal bleeding, petechiae, and bruising in a previously healthy 4-year-old is classic for this condition. I recommend requesting a Complete Blood Count (CBC) with a peripheral smear to confirm low platelet count. REQUEST TEST: CBC_with_differential_and_platelet_count.
